export_video_array: encode a numpy array or torch tensor of video frames to an MP4 file at a given path
thwc_to_cthw: permute a torch tensor from time-height-width-channel layout to channel-height-width-time layout
secs_to_pts: convert a time in seconds to presentation timestamp using a given time base and start offset
load_dataclass_dict_from_csv: load a CSV file into a dictionary of dataclass objects keyed by a specified field name
save_dataclass_objs_to_headered_csv: save a list of dataclass objects to a CSV file with header row and field values
